Ex: The promotion helped the company reach a much broader audience.

items.vn: (verb). Làm cho phì nhiêu, làm cho màu m
items.example: Ex: They will build a dam for the cattle to drink from, and they will fertilize the soil with manure.
Ex: There may be some minor changes to the schedule.
Ex: Alterations have been carried out on a piecemeal basis.
Ex: It is just a fairy tale unrelated to the real world.
Ex: Today police launched a campaign to reduce road accidents.

items.vn: (noun). Sự tạo thành, sự sáng tạo
items.example: Ex: Job creation needs to be the top priority.
Ex: A huge crowd had gathered in the square.
Ex: She was a perfectly ordinary little girl.
Ex: The product has a guaranteed shelf life of 60 days.
Ex: He had finally achieved success.
Ex: Expansion into the global market brings more risk.
Ex: She is developing the commercial side of the organization.
Ex: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.

items.vn: (adjective). không có sẵn, không dùng được
items.example: Ex: Such luxuries are unavailable to ordinary people.
Ex: New scientific discoveries are being made all the time.
Ex: The pharmaceutical industry has little incentive to develop new drugs for use primarily in developing countries.

items.vn: (noun). nỗi khổ sở, nỗi đau đớn
items.example: Ex: These poor people are in great affliction.

items.vn: (noun). Sự tìm ra, sự khám phá, điều tìm thấy
items.example: Ex: Our research findings indicate that pregnant women benefit from this treatment.
Ex: The building is an architectural marvel.
Ex: She has said nothing regarding your request.
Ex: Smoking increases the risk of stroke.
Ex: Wildlife is fast disappearing from our countryside.
Ex: The design has many applications.
Ex: There are lots of people there who can actually help you.
Ex: Detectives are currently investigating possible links between the murders.
Ex: We have compiled a list of 10 potential candidates.
Ex: It is the world's largest software company.
Ex: Further experimentation is needed to verify this hypothesis.
Ex: The fall of the old regime provided fertile ground for opportunism.
Ex: The effects of weathering can be simulated in the laboratory.
Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.
Ex: His researches in the field of disease prevention produced unexpected results.
Ex: Education is the current focus of public debate.
Ex: It was a word he used frequently.
Ex: Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.
Ex: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.
Ex: Our US sales have now overtaken our sales in Europe.
Ex: He was in London publicizing his new biography of Kennedy.

items.vn: (noun). Tính khả dụng, sự có sẵn
items.example: Ex: I shall check the availability of my staff for that date.
Ex: The hospital is carrying out tests to find out what's wrong with her.
Ex: You can choose to only watch certain kinds of movies.
Ex: Food is necessary for survival.
Ex:  It seems odd that nobody noticed anything wrong.
Ex: Only about half of the original workforce remains.
Ex: If you can't deliver improved sales figures, you're fired.

items.vn: (adverb). đáng kinh ngạc, đến không ngờ
items.example: Ex: It was all incredibly difficult.
Ex: She wishes to pursue a medical career.
Ex: It's a relatively straightforward process.
Ex: She regarded her patients from a purely clinical standpoint.
Ex: Paper is relatively inexpensive here.
Ex: It is possible to get there by bus.
Ex: They're doing clinical trials on a new drug.

sections.title: Passage 1: Snow-makers
sections.html:
artificial

(adjective). nhân tạo

All food served in the restaurant is completely free from any artificial colours and flavours.

process

(noun). quá trình

Each time we have to go through the whole decision-making process again.

natural

(adjective). tự nhiên

We should respect animals and the natural environment, which is their home.

product

(noun). sản phẩm

He has eliminated dairy products from his diet.

differently

(adverb). một cách khác

Boys and girls may behave differently.

weather

(noun). thời tiết

Flights have been delayed because of the inclement weather.

accomplish

(verb). đạt được

The first part of the plan has been safely accomplished.

exactly

(adverb). một cách chính xác

It happened almost exactly a year ago.

snowflake

(noun). bông tuyết

A single snowflake landed on her nose.

variety

(noun). sự đa dạng

There is a wide variety of patterns to choose from.

dense

(adjective). dày đặc

The forest is quite dense at that point.

underneath

(adverb). bên dưới

This jacket's too big, even with a sweater underneath.

regularly

(adverb). thường xuyên

He admitted that he regularly used drugs.

coat

(verb). phủ

The cookies were thickly coated with chocolate.

trail

(noun). đường mòn

The hurricane left a trail of destruction behind it.

layer

(noun). tầng, lớp

How many layers of clothing are you wearing?

throughout

(preposition). khắp, suốt

They export their products to markets throughout the world.

method

(noun). phương pháp

Which method is the most effective?

modification

(noun). Sự làm giảm nhẹ, sự bớt đi, sự dịu đi

Considerable modification of the existing system is needed.

adjust

(verb). điều chỉnh

Watch out for sharp bends and adjust your speed accordingly.

proportion

(noun). tỷ lệ

Water covers a large proportion of the earth's surface.

central

(adjective). quan trọng

The central issue is that of widespread racism.

ecological

(adjective). liên quan đến hệ sinh thái

We risk upsetting the ecological balance of the area.

environment

(noun). môi trường

The government should do more to protect the environment.

demand

(noun). yêu cầu

A federal judge rejected their demands.

application

(noun). đơn xin việc

You need to complete the online application form.

compress

(verb). ép

As more snow fell, the bottom layer was compressed into ice.

hose

(noun). ống mềm, ống cao su

You need a fire hose; a garden hose isn't powerful enough to tackle a fire.

atomise

(verb). tán nhỏ, chia nhỏ

If this trend continues, there is a risk that the whole sector will atomize.

disrupt

(verb). phá vở

Demonstrators succeeded in disrupting the meeting.

stream

(noun). dòng suối

We waded across a shallow stream.

split

(verb). chia

He was a member of the team that split the atom in 1932.

droplet

(noun). giọt nhỏ

Infectious diseases are spread by airborne droplets.

tiny

(adjective). rất nhỏ

We come from a tiny little town in upstate New York.

form

(verb). tạo thành

Rearrange the letters to form a new word.

crystal

(noun). pha lê

Every table had been set with fine china and crystal.

surface

(noun). bề mặt

These plants float on the surface of the water.

build up

(verb). tăng lên với số lượng nhiều

All the pressure built up and he was off work for weeks with stress.

increase

(verb). tăng

Costs have increased significantly.

consistency

(noun). thống nhất, nhất quán

She has played with great consistency all season.

atmosphere

(noun). bầu khí quyển

Wind power doesn't release carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.

temperature

(noun). nhiệt độ

The temperature has risen (by) five degrees.

humidity

(noun). sự ẩm ướt, độ ẩm

Instruments constantly monitor temperature and humidity.

outdoor

(adjective). ngoài trời

They sell camping equipment, hiking gear and outdoor clothing.

machinery

(noun). máy móc

These workshops were built to house heavy machinery.

considerable

(adjective). nhiều

The project wasted a considerable amount of time and money.

pump

(noun). máy bơm

She washed her face at the pump in front of the inn.

damaging

(adjective). có hại

Lead is potentially damaging to children's health.

agriculture

(noun). ngành nông nghiệp

The number of people employed in agriculture has fallen in the last decade.

man-made

(adjective). nhân tạo

man-made fibres such as nylon and polyester

crop

(noun). cây trồng

What are the benefits of growing GM crops?

plant

(noun). cây, thực vật

All plants need light and water.

insulation

(noun). sự cách nhiệt

Better insulation of your home will help to reduce heating bills.

safety

(noun). an toàn

He was kept in custody for his own safety.

function

(noun). chức năng

The club serves a useful function as a meeting place.

check

(verb). kiểm tra

She gave me the minutes of the meeting to read and check.

aircraft

(noun). máy bay, tàu bay

The aircraft was flown by a young American pilot.

profitable

(adjective). lợi nhuận

It is usually more profitable to sell direct to the public.

vapour

(noun). hơi

The particles then form a vapour.

condense

(verb). ngưng tụ

Steam condenses into water when it cools.

reservoir

(noun). hồ chứa

The water content of the country's reservoirs had fallen to less than 50% of their capacity.

powdery

(adjective). phủ bột

This is a fine powdery flour used in baking.

extreme

(adjective). vô cùng, cực độ

We are working under extreme pressure at the moment.

maximum

(noun). mức tối đa

The table has a length of four feet maximum.

dependent

(adjective). phụ thuộc

He has three dependent children.

run-off

(verb). rời nơi nào đó bất ngờ

You can't run off (home) now, just when I need you!

sections.title: Passage 2: Why are so few tigers man-eaters?
sections.html:
account

(noun). Lời tường thuật

Ex: The diaries contained a detailed account of the writer's experiences in China.

adventure

(noun). cuộc phiêu lưu

Ex: When you're a child, life is one big adventure.

ancestral

(adjective). thuộc ông bà tổ tiên, do tổ tiên truyền lại

Ex: Her musical gifts are a kind of ancestral heritage passed to her from her grandmother.

brave

(adjective). can đảm, dũng cảm

Ex: I wasn't brave enough to tell her what I thought of her.

breathless

(adjective). hổn hển, không kịp thở

Ex: The children peered through the open door, breathless with excitement.

common

(adjective). chung, phổ biến

Ex:They share a common interest in photography.

constant

(adjective). liên tục

Ex: There were constant interruptions.

distinguish

(verb). phân biệt

Ex: At what age are children able to distinguish between right and wrong?

encourage

(verb). khuyến khích

Ex: My parents have always encouraged me in my choice of career.

enrage

(verb). làm điên tiết, làm nổi khùng

Ex: She was enraged at his stupidity.

frightened

(adjective). Sợ hãi

Ex: I'm frightened of walking home alone in the dark.

impression

(noun). ấn tượng

Ex: She gives the impression of being very busy.

intriguing

(adjective). Hấp dẫn

Ex: These discoveries raise intriguing questions.

menace

(verb). Đe doạ, uy hiếp

Ex: The forests are being menaced by major development projects.

siege

(noun). sự bao vây

Ex: This fortress could withstand a siege for years if necessary.

solitary

(adjective). Đơn độc

Ex: She enjoys long solitary walks.

survive

(verb). Sống sót, tồn tại

Ex: They spent two months in the jungle, surviving on small animals and fruit.

suspect

(verb). nghi ngờ

Ex: She had no reason to suspect that Anna had not been telling the truth.

unpredictable

(adjective). Không thể đoán trước

Ex: The result is entirely unpredictable.

upright

(adjective). thẳng đứng

Ex: Try to maintain an upright posture while doing this exercise.

arm

(verb). Trang bị vũ khí

Ex: he men armed themselves with sticks and stones.

assume

(verb). Phỏng đoán

Ex: Let us assume for a moment that the plan succeeds.

constraint

(noun). sự hạn chế

Ex: This decision will impose serious constraints on all schools.

reject

(verb). Từ chối, bác bỏ

Ex: The bank has the option of accepting or rejecting this offer.

attack

(noun). sự tấn công

Ex: A child is recovering in hospital after a serious attack by a stray dog.

rare

(adjective). Hiếm hoi, hiếm

Ex: It is rare to find such loyalty these days.

explanation

(noun). giải thích

Ex: The most likely explanation is that his plane was delayed.

fear

(noun). nỗi sợ

Ex: Alan spoke of his fears for the future.

afraid

(adjective). hãi, hoảng, hoảng sợ

Ex: They know I'm afraid of heights.

expect

(verb). mong đợi

Ex: They never expected to find their dream home.

frequent

(adjective). thường xuyên

Ex: There is a frequent bus service into the centre of town.

jungle

(noun). rừng

Ex: The area was covered in dense jungle.

strange

(adjective). Kỳ lạ; lạ thường

Ex: She was looking at me in a very strange way.

situation

(noun). tình huống

Ex: There is no doubt that the current situation is very serious.

involve

(verb). liên quan, bao hàm

Ex: The test will involve answering questions about a photograph.

attack

(verb). tấn công

Ex: Most wild animals won't attack unless they are provoked.

fodder

(noun). cỏ khô

Ex: The drying up of food, fodder and feed will eventually affect milk production.

incident

(noun). Sự việc

Ex: He came to regret the whole incident.

material

(noun). Chất liệu

Ex: We have 98% of the same genetic material as chimpanzees.

claim

(noun). lời tuyên bố

Ex: The company had made false claims about its products.

frequency

(noun). Tần suất

Ex: Complaints about the frequency of buses rose in the last year.

proportion

(noun). Tỷ lệ

Ex: The proportion of regular smokers increases with age.

appear to

(verb). dường như, có vẻ như

Ex: The couple appeared to have nothing in common.

base on

(verb). dựa vào

Ex: What are you basing this theory on?

attempt

(verb). cố gắng, nỗ lực

Ex: I will attempt to answer all your questions.

behaviour

(noun). hành vi

Ex: I noticed a change in his behaviour.

ethology

(noun). Tập tính học

Ex: The discovery and translation of the bee's "dance" is one of the great achievements of modern ethology.

impose

(verb). áp đặt

Ex: The government has imposed a ban on the sale of handguns.

observe

(verb). Quan sát

Ex: I want you to observe all the details.

principle

(noun). Nguyên tắc, nguyên lí

Ex: She went on to explain the principles behind what she was doing.

require

(verb). cần, yêu cầu

Ex: These pets require a lot of care and attention.

significance

(noun). sự quan trọng, sự đáng kể

Ex: The new drug has great significance for the treatment of the disease.

tiny

(adjective). rất nhỏ

Ex: We come from a tiny little town in upstate New York.

notice

(noun). yết thị, thông báo

Ex: There was a notice on the board saying the class had been cancelled.

placid

(adjective). yên lặng, điềm tĩnh

Ex: The cattle are placid, so easy to work with.

species

(noun). giống loài

Ex: Most of the known rhino species are West African.

huge

(adjective). to lớn

Ex: A huge crowd had gathered in the square.

exaggerate

(verb). Phóng đại

Ex: The hotel was really filthy and I'm not exaggerating.

overstate

(verb). cường điệu, phóng đại

Ex: He tends to overstate his case when talking politics.

spread

(verb). Dàn trải, lan toả

Ex: The fire spread very rapidly because of the strong wind.

terror

(noun). Sự kinh hoàng, sự khiếp sợ

Ex: Her eyes were wild with terror.

inherit

(verb). kế thừa

Ex: She inherited a fortune from her father.

instinct

(noun). bản năng

Ex: She did not seem to have any of the usual maternal instincts.

perhaps

(adverb). có thể, có lẽ

Ex: This is perhaps his best novel to date.

claim

(verb). tuyên bố, cho là

Ex: She's not the saint that many have claimed her to be.

elegant

(adjective). thanh thoát, tao nhã

Ex: This is a fine building of elegant proportions.

experiment

(noun). thử nghiệm, thí nghiệm

Ex: Some people believe that experiments on animals should be banned.

field

(noun). lĩnh vực

Ex: Child development is such an interesting field.

naturalist

(noun). nhà tự nhiên học

Ex: Some nineteenth-century naturalists denied that animals possessed any mental qualities besides instincts.’

pioneer

(noun). người tiên phong, người mở đường

Ex: The pioneers went west across North America, cutting down forests and planting new crops.

slightly

(adverb). nhỏ, không đáng kể

Ex: She earns slightly less than $100 000 a year.

creature

(noun). Sinh vật

Ex: Dogs are more social creatures than cats.

cub

(noun). Con thú con hổ, sư tử, sói, gấu, cáo...

Ex: Lion cubs, if left alone, can be vulnerable to other large predators.

realise

(verb). nhận ra

Ex: They didn't realise the danger they were in.

risk

(noun). rủi ro, nguy hiểm

Ex: The health risks are very low.

rarely

(adverb). hiếm

Ex: The term is rarely used today.

confused

(adjective). rối rắm, lẫn lộn

Ex: The children gave a confused account of what had happened.

directly

(adverb). một cách trực tiếp

Ex: He was not directly responsible for the accident.

disappear

(verb). biến mất

Ex: Wildlife is fast disappearing from our countryside.

movement

(noun). Chuyển động

Ex: Loose clothing gives you greater freedom of movement.

prey

(noun). Con mồi

Ex: Unable to get close its prey, the tiger walked backwards disappearing into the darkness.

puzzled

(adjective). lúng túng, bối rối

Ex: She had a puzzled look on her face.

tackle

(verb). xử lí, chặn lại

Ex: He tackled a masked intruder at his home.

unable

(adjective). Không thể

Ex: I was unable to attend the meeting, but sent my apologies.

disconcerted

(adjective). Bối rối, lúng túng, luống cuống

Ex: I was disconcerted to find that everyone else already knew it.

approach

(noun). sự tiếp cận, sự lại gần

Ex: She hadn't heard his approach and jumped as the door opened.

relation

(noun). mối quan hệ

Ex: Little of what he said has any relation to fact.

invisible

(adjective). Vô hình

Ex: She felt invisible in the crowd.

opposite

(noun). Điều trái ngược; sự đối lập

Ex: What is the opposite of heavy?

resemble

(verb). Tạo hình giống nhau

Ex: The plant resembles grass in appearance.

theory

(noun). Giả thuyết; học thuyết

Ex: He has a theory that the hole was caused by a meteorite.

unaware

(adjective). không để ý

Ex: Cassie waited silently, knowing they were unaware of her presence

vulnerable

(adjective). dễ bị tổn thương

Ex: Old people are particularly vulnerable to the flu.

sections.title: Passage 3: Keep taking the tablets
sections.html:
accidental

(adjective). tình cờ

Ex: I didn't think our meeting was accidental—he must have known I would be there.

ache

(verb). Đau, nhức, nhức nhối

Ex: Her eyes ached from lack of sleep.

astonishingly

(adverb). Đáng kinh ngạc

Ex: Astonishingly, a crowd of several thousands turned out to hear him.

boost

(verb). thúc đẩy

Ex: The movie helped boost her screen career.

corporate

(adjective). thuộc đoàn thể

Ex: All adults take corporate responsibility for the upbringing of the tribe's children.

deadly

(adjective). gây chết người, chí mạng

Ex: The cobra is one of the world's deadliest snakes.

describe

(verb). miêu tả

Ex: Can you describe him to me?

disease

(noun). Căn bệnh, dịch bệnh

Ex: Smoking increases the risk of heart disease.

disincentive

(noun). Sự làm nản lòng, sự làm thoái chí

ease

(verb). Làm dễ chịu, làm đỡ đau

Ex: This should help ease the pain.

explain

(verb). giải thích

Ex: He was trying to explain the difference between hip hop and rap.

explore

(verb). khám phá, thám hiểm

Ex: We will explore these ideas in more detail in chapter 7.

fever

(noun). sốt

Ex: He's got a headache and a slight fever.

innovate

(verb). Đổi mới, cách tân

Ex: We must constantly adapt and innovate to ensure success in a growing market.

inquiry

(noun). Sự điều tra, sự thẩm tra

Ex: The database management system offers a facility for on-line update and inquiry.

intense

(adjective). dữ dội

Ex: He suddenly felt an intense pain in his back.

intuitive

(adjective). thuộc về trực giác

Ex: He had an intuitive sense of what the reader wanted.

nature

(noun). bản chất

Ex: His work explores the nature of the mother-child relationship.

patent

(noun). bằng sáng chế

Ex: The device was protected by patent.

property

(noun). thuộc tính, tính chất

Ex: The substance has properties similar to plastic.

regulation

(noun). sự quy định, sự điều khiển

Ex: Food additives are subject to government regulation.

relieve

(verb). làm dịu đi, làm nhẹ bớt

Ex: They try to relieve the symptoms of depression by drinking.

remind

(verb). nhắc cho nhớ

Ex: Could you remind Paul about dinner on Saturday?

rivalry

(noun). Sự cạnh tranh, sự ganh đua

Ex: There is a certain amount of friendly rivalry between the teams.

sector

(noun). khu vực

Ex: We have seen rapid growth in the services sector.

society

(noun). xã hội

Ex: Every section of society must have access to education.

solution

(noun). Giải pháp

Ex: Attempts to find a solution have failed.

temperature

(noun). Nhiệt độ

Ex: The climate is generally mild, and freezing temperatures are almost unknown.

therapeutic

(adjective). thuộc điều trị, trị liệu

Ex: For arthritis sufferers, moderate exercise is therapeutic.

tiny

(adjective). rất nhỏ

Ex: We come from a tiny little town in upstate New York.

treat

(verb). chữa

Ex: She was treated for depression with medication prescribed by her doctor.

versatile

(adjective). linh hoạt

Ex: Eggs are easy to cook and are an extremely versatile food.

ancient

(adjective). cổ đại

Ex: People have lived in this valley since ancient times.

aware

(adjective). Có nhận thức

Ex: They suddenly became aware of people looking at them.

extract

(noun). chiết suất

Ex: The cream contained extracts from several plants.

physician

(noun). Thầy thuốc

Ex: Please consult your physician before beginning any new exercise program.

recommend

(verb). gợi ý, giới thiệu

Ex: I recommend the book to all my students.

remedy

(noun). Phương thuốc; Cách giải quyết

Ex: There is no simple remedy for unemployment.

painkiller

(noun). thuốc giảm đau

Ex: The body produces chemicals that are natural painkillers.

analgesic

(noun). thuốc giảm đau

Ex: Aspirin is a mild analgesic.

medical

(adjective). Liên quan đến y khoa

Ex: His medical records showed that he was unfit for work.

compound

(noun). Hợp chất

Ex: The air smelled like a compound of diesel and petrol fumes.

effective

(adjective). Có hiệu quả

Ex: Aspirin is a simple but highly effective treatment.

identify

(verb). Xác định, nhận dạng

Ex: They are trying to identify what is wrong with the present system.

ingredient

(noun). Thành phần, nguyên liệu

Ex: Our skin cream contains only natural ingredients.

race

(noun). Cuộc đua

Ex: Three newspapers are involved in a race to publish the story.

relatively

(adjective). vừa phải, tương đối

Ex: I found the test relatively easy.

replicate

(verb). Sao chép, bắt chước

Ex: Researchers tried many times to replicate the original experiment.

reproduce

(verb). Sao chép, chép lại

Ex: The photocopier reproduces colours very well.

synthetically

(adverb). Tổng hợp; nhân tạo

Ex: Originally made from the bark of a willow tree, today it is made synthetically.

due to

(phrase). vì

Ex: A lot of her unhappiness is due to boredom.

means

(noun). phương tiện

Ex: They had no means of communication

breakthrough

(noun). Bước đột phá

Ex: Scientists are hoping for a breakthrough in the search for a cure for cancer.

determination

(noun). Tính quả quyết; quyết tâm

Ex: He fought the illness with courage and determination.

motive

(noun). động cơ

Ex: He was suspicious of her motives in inviting him into the house.

reality

(noun). thực tại

Ex: He refuses to face reality

revolution

(noun). cuộc cách mạng

Ex: A revolution in information technology is taking place.

advance

(noun). sự tiến bộ, bước tiến

Ex: We live in an age of rapid technological advance.

broad

(adjective). Rộng lớn

Ex: The promotion helped the company reach a much broader audience.

fertilise

(verb). Làm cho phì nhiêu, làm cho màu m

Ex: They will build a dam for the cattle to drink from, and they will fertilize the soil with manure.

minor

(adjective). Nhỏ lẻ, không quan trọng

Ex: There may be some minor changes to the schedule.

piecemeal

(adjective). từng phần một; dần dần

Ex: Alterations have been carried out on a piecemeal basis.

unrelated

(adjective). không có liên quan

Ex: It is just a fairy tale unrelated to the real world.

campaign

(noun). Chiến dịch

Ex: Today police launched a campaign to reduce road accidents.

creation

(noun). Sự tạo thành, sự sáng tạo

Ex: Job creation needs to be the top priority.

huge

(adjective). to lớn

Ex: A huge crowd had gathered in the square.

ordinary

(adjective). Bình thường

Ex: She was a perfectly ordinary little girl.

shelf life

(phrase). tuổi thọ

Ex: The product has a guaranteed shelf life of 60 days.

achieve

(verb). Đạt được, giành được

Ex: He had finally achieved success.

market

(noun). thị trường

Ex: Expansion into the global market brings more risk.

commercial

(adjective). mang tính thương mại

Ex: She is developing the commercial side of the organization.

ensure

(verb). Đảm bảo

Ex: We are working to ensure the safety of people in the city.

unavailable

(adjective). không có sẵn, không dùng được

Ex: Such luxuries are unavailable to ordinary people.

discovery

(noun). khám phá

Ex: New scientific discoveries are being made all the time.

pharmaceutical

(adjective). thuộc dược phẩm

Ex: The pharmaceutical industry has little incentive to develop new drugs for use primarily in developing countries.

affliction

(noun). nỗi khổ sở, nỗi đau đớn

Ex: These poor people are in great affliction.

finding

(noun). Sự tìm ra, sự khám phá, điều tìm thấy

Ex: Our research findings indicate that pregnant women benefit from this treatment.

marvel

(noun). điều kì diệu, kỳ công

Ex: The building is an architectural marvel.

regarding

(preposition). về, đối với

Ex: She has said nothing regarding your request.

stroke

(noun). đột quỵ

Ex: Smoking increases the risk of stroke.

disappear

(verb). biến mất

Ex: Wildlife is fast disappearing from our countryside.

application

(noun). ứng dụng

Ex: The design has many applications.

actually

(adverb). thực sự

Ex: There are lots of people there who can actually help you.

investigate

(verb). Điều tra

Ex: Detectives are currently investigating possible links between the murders.

potential

(adjective). Tiềm năng

Ex: We have compiled a list of 10 potential candidates.

company

(noun). công ty

Ex: It is the world's largest software company.

experimentation

(noun). sự thí nghiệm

Ex: Further experimentation is needed to verify this hypothesis.

fertile

(adjective). thúc đẩy sự phát triển

Ex: The fall of the old regime provided fertile ground for opportunism.

laboratory

(noun). Phòng thí nghiệm

Ex: The effects of weathering can be simulated in the laboratory.

significant

(adjective). Đáng lưu ý, quan trọng

Ex: There are no significant differences between the two groups of students.

research

(noun). nghiên cứu

Ex: His researches in the field of disease prevention produced unexpected results.

focus

(noun). Trọng tâm, sự tập trung

Ex: Education is the current focus of public debate.

frequently

(adverb). thường xuyên

Ex: It was a word he used frequently.

pattern

(noun). Khuôn mẫu

Ex: Wages in both sectors have followed a similar pattern.

focus

(verb). tập trung

Ex: She was distracted and finding it hard to focus.

overtake

(verb). vượt qua

Ex: Our US sales have now overtaken our sales in Europe.

publicise

(verb). công khai, quảng cáo

Ex: He was in London publicizing his new biography of Kennedy.

availability

(noun). Tính khả dụng, sự có sẵn

Ex: I shall check the availability of my staff for that date.

carry out

(verb). tiến hành

Ex: The hospital is carrying out tests to find out what's wrong with her.

certain

(adjective). nhất định, nào đó

Ex: You can choose to only watch certain kinds of movies.

necessary

(adjective). cần thiết

Ex: Food is necessary for survival.

odd

(adjective). Kì lạ

Ex: It seems odd that nobody noticed anything wrong.

remain

(verb). tồn tại

Ex: Only about half of the original workforce remains.

deliver

(verb). cung cấp

Ex: If you can't deliver improved sales figures, you're fired.

incredibly

(adverb). đáng kinh ngạc, đến không ngờ

Ex: It was all incredibly difficult.

pursue

(verb). Theo đuổi

Ex: She wishes to pursue a medical career.

straightforward

(adjective). minh bạch

Ex: It's a relatively straightforward process.

clinical

(adjective). lâm sàng

Ex: She regarded her patients from a purely clinical standpoint.

inexpensive

(adjective). rẻ

Ex: Paper is relatively inexpensive here.

possible

(adjective). có thể

Ex: It is possible to get there by bus.

trial

(noun). thử nghiệm

Ex: They're doing clinical trials on a new drug.
